# GreenKube

> GreenKube is an open-source optimization loop for Kubernetes clusters run with GitOps.
> Every recommendation. One pull request. Proven savings.

## What is GreenKube?

GreenKube collects Kubernetes optimization recommendations from many sources, cross-analyses their value and risk, delivers the best ones as reviewable pull requests to the GitOps repository (Argo CD or Flux), verifies that the change was synced and is live, and measures what each change actually saved against a counterfactual: in money, in CO₂e, and in released capacity (CPU cores and memory freed, projected and measured, never converted to money). Outcomes are recorded in an append-only, hash-chained savings ledger. It runs in the cluster it optimizes, on-premises and on clouds.

- **License:** Apache 2.0
- **Deployment:** one Helm chart (API, controller, isolated renderer, PostgreSQL); no profile, no feature flag
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/GreenKubeCloud/GreenKube
- **Docker Hub:** https://hub.docker.com/r/greenkube/greenkube
- **Artifact Hub:** https://artifacthub.io/packages/helm/greenkube/greenkube
- **Documentation:** https://docs.greenkube.cloud/
- **Live demo:** https://demo.greenkube.cloud
- **Helm Repository:** https://GreenKubeCloud.github.io/GreenKube

## Principles

- Git is the only write path: no admission webhooks, no in-place mutation.
- Projected savings are never shown as realized; projected, measured allocated and realized (billed) savings are never summed.
- Fail closed and explain why.
- Neutral by design: GreenKube's own analyzers are one source among others.

## The loop

1. Aggregate: GreenKube analyzers, VPA and Goldilocks, Robusta KRR, Kubecost, Fairwinds Polaris, GKE recommender, Azure Advisor, Karpenter NodePools, and a push API with a public signal schema.
2. Cross-analyse: consensus across sources, evidence, projected impact (Impact Model), risk, confidence, expected value, delivery eligibility.
3. Deliver: plan rendered in an isolated sandbox, approved by digest, pull request on GitHub, GitLab or Gitea (raw YAML, Kustomize, Helm including remote charts).
4. Verify: Argo CD or Flux sync tracking and apply detection.
5. Measure: 7-day baseline, load-adjusted counterfactual, 90% confidence interval with a noise floor, confounder checks, health gates, drift monitor.
6. Record: append-only, hash-chained ledger with CSV and FOCUS-aligned exports.

## Quick Start

```bash
docker run --rm -p 9000:9000 greenkube/greenkube demo --no-browser --port 9000
helm repo add greenkube https://GreenKubeCloud.github.io/GreenKube && helm repo update
helm install greenkube greenkube/greenkube -n greenkube --create-namespace
```
